description: Built-in dictionary library ids in precedence order: when two enabled built-in libraries list the same spoken form, the one earlier here supplies the rule, and this order decides which terms fill the on-device AI cleanup glossary. The first eleven are the order Scribe 0.4.3 composed them in (category, then name, ordinal and case-insensitive), frozen as ids so a rename or a new category never moves a library. Append a new built-in at the end; never reorder or remove an id. Windows keeps the same list in Scribe.Core.Libraries.LibraryPrecedence.BuiltInOrder, and LibraryPrecedenceTests fails until the two agree. Custom libraries come after every built-in, in the order of their file names.
